<title level="1" right="Action">[Weighted Kick](/Actions.aspx?ID=2101) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 109

</column>

---

Your augdunar gives a heavy kick with its hind legs, bringing the weight of its burden on the target. It makes a hoof Strike. On a successful hit, the augdunar automatically [Shoves](/Actions.aspx?ID=38) the target back 5 feet (10 feet on a critical success).
name: Weighted Kick
